$comment: S36 KSDMA post-disaster assessment (T122, D123). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s36.yaml.

fields.name: document_id
fields.meaning: PDF file name, for example Memorandum1-Floods-2018.pdf

fields.name: page
fields.meaning: PDF page number of the table

fields.name: district_id
fields.meaning: District name as published (spellings vary, for example Alleppey, Alappuzha); not a district ID

fields.name: claim_type
fields.meaning: flooded_area_ha or human_fatalities, from the table header

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: District total for the table: hectares or persons

fields.name: unit
fields.meaning: ha or persons, from the header

fields.name: event_date
fields.meaning: 'as on' date of the table; null for whole-period totals (date_basis=period_total)

fields.name: date_basis
fields.meaning: as_on (table date) or period_total (whole memorandum period)

fields.name: period_start
fields.meaning: First day of the memorandum period

fields.name: period_end
fields.meaning: Last day of the memorandum period

fields.name: excerpt
fields.meaning: Table row text, whitespace normalized, for tracing to document and page

valid_at: as_on tables: 00:00 IST of the table date; period totals: 00:00 IST the day after the period
not_included: ward or taluk figures, flood-notified ward counts, other tables, the PDNA and the 2013 memorandum; place_id stays null
